```python
import httpx

async def run_pipeline_concurrent(payload: dict):
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:
        # Fetch alternatives and recipes concurrently after analysis
        alt_task = client.post(ALTERNATIVE_URL, json=payload)
        rec_task = client.post(RECIPE_URL, json=payload)
        alt_resp, rec_resp = await asyncio.gather(alt_task, rec_task)
        return alt_resp.json(), rec_resp.json()
```

Under FSSAI regulations, Sodium Benzoate is permitted up to 120 ppm in carbonated/ready-to-serve beverages. It is flagged because in the presence of ascorbic acid (Vitamin C), it can react to synthesize trace benzene, an established carcinogen.

Yes. Under FSSAI HFSS (High Fat, Sugar, Salt) threshold guidelines, solid packaged foods exceeding 350mg sodium per 100g require front-of-pack warning labels. A content of 2300mg sodium per 100g substantially exceeds the permissible threshold.

Erythrosine is an approved synthetic red food colour (INS 127), permitted up to 100 mg/kg. There is no recognized 'Erythrosine Blue' dye under FSSAI regulations; blue food dyes are Brilliant Blue FCF and Indigo Carmine.
Polyglycitol Syrup (INS 964) is not banned in India. Under FSSAI regulations, it is an authorized polyol sweetener permitted under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards.
